# SCHLÜSSELMACHER24 - Architecture and Guidelines

This document outlines the architectural goals and Next.js 16+ best practices for the SCHLÜSSELMACHER24 codebase.

## Frameworks & Tools
- Next.js 16+ App Router
- React 19.2+ Server Components & Server Actions
- Tailwind CSS v4 (OKLCH Light Mode)
- TypeScript 5.5+ Strict

## Design Doctrine (Swiss Light Mode Marken-DNA)
- **Base Canvas:** `oklch(0.988 0.002 260)`
- **Elevated Surface:** `oklch(0.968 0.004 260)`
- **Text Primary:** `oklch(0.16 0.02 260)`
- **Text Secondary:** `oklch(0.32 0.02 260)`
- **Focal Accent:** `oklch(0.52 0.24 260)` (International Klein Blue)

## Zero-New-Routes Invariant
Modifications must only enhance physically existing routes. Creating new routes or speculative dynamic slugs is strictly forbidden.
